answer: The gale schedule is applied in falcon and ivory reveals each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 27% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4037 identities would post 734 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
